## Activity

During July 2019, Central Eye Clinic recorded 164 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. All reported captures are included in the monthly activity figure, allowing the service to monitor the volume submitted for assessment.

## Image quality

Of the 164 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.8 per cent. This indicates that only a small proportion of the images could not be used for grading. The image-quality result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for Central Eye Clinic during July 2019.

## Grading

There were 30 referable results during the month. The median grading lag was 1 day. Together, these figures describe the grading workload and the time taken for results to progress through grading. The reported activity, image-quality, and grading measures provide a concise operational summary for Central Eye Clinic for July 2019.
